name: retired_installed_product_status_update
description: Verifies that the installed product with ID 21 was updated to retired status for the specified account, product, and location.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 21 AND account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND serial_number = 'P152-537224-3992' AND status = 'retired' AND location_id = 809;

name: new_installed_product_registration
description: Verifies that the replacement installed product was registered with in_use status at the same account, product, and location.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 301 AND account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND serial_number = 'P152-648335-99' AND status = 'in_use' AND location_id = 809;

name: installed_product_replacement_pair_validation
description: Verifies that exactly one retired unit and one in_use replacement exist for the same account, product, and location.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product WHERE account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND location_id = 809 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installed_product WHERE account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND location_id = 809 AND serial_number = 'P152-537224-3992' AND status = 'retired') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM installed_product WHERE account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND location_id = 809 AND serial_number = 'P152-648335-99' AND status = 'in_use');

name: documentation_case_creation
description: Verifies that documentation case CS-0001233 was created with correct attributes and linked to the new installed product.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND number = 'CS-0001233' AND account_id = 4 AND contact_id = 2 AND product_id = 152 AND installed_product_id = 301 AND channel = 'web' AND priority = 'moderate' AND state = 'new' AND assigned_to = 3 AND assignment_group_id IS NULL AND escalation = 0 AND reopen_count = 0 AND closed_on IS NULL;

name: case_to_replacement_product_linkage
description: Verifies that the case is linked only to the new in_use installed product and not the retired unit.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case c INNER JOIN installed_product ip ON c.installed_product_id = ip.installed_product_id WHERE c.case_id = 1233 AND c.installed_product_id = 301 AND ip.status = 'in_use' AND ip.serial_number = 'P152-648335-99' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1233 AND installed_product_id = 21);

name: active_entitlement_validation
description: Verifies that an active premium entitlement exists for the account and product before case creation.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement WHERE entitlement_id = 32 AND account_id = 4 AND product_id = 152 AND active = 1 AND support_level = 'premium';

name: case_assignment_to_active_agent
description: Verifies that the case is assigned to an active agent with the correct role.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case c INNER JOIN user u ON c.assigned_to = u.user_id WHERE c.case_id = 1233 AND c.assigned_to = 3 AND u.email = 'tabitha.bullock@servicenow.com' AND u.role = 'agent' AND u.active = 1;

name: no_retired_or_repair_products_attached
description: Verifies that the case is linked only to an in_use installed product and not to retired or repair units.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case c INNER JOIN installed_product ip ON c.installed_product_id = ip.installed_product_id WHERE c.case_id = 1233 AND ip.status = 'in_use' AND ip.status NOT IN ('retired', 'repair');
